description: Image Description: The image displays a market stall featuring a variety of bananas arranged in an organized display. In the foreground, two large bunches of ripe yellow bananas are placed on white paper sheets atop a dark brown surface. These bananas are uniformly curved and have green tips, indicating freshness. Behind them, several smaller bunches of bananas are stacked in rows, some grouped tightly and others loosely arranged. A sign in the center reads "BABY BANANA 1.49¢ LB," written
